data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing multiple calendar views and event management functionality.
data.what_it_does: Provides Month, Day, and Week calendar views with support for managing events, reminders, and full-day events. Allows high customization of UI components and syncing event data between multiple views.
use_when: You need to implement fully customizable calendar views like Month, Day, and Week views in your app.
You want to manage calendar events, reminders, and multi-day events with event data synchronization.
You need built-in localization, RTL support, and dark theme support for calendars.
avoid_when: You only need a simple date picker instead of full calendar grids and event scheduling.
You want a zero-configuration calendar widget with no custom event management logic.
strengths: Multiple built-in calendar view options (Month, Day, Week)
Comprehensive event, reminder, and multi-day event management
Highly customizable UI components, builders, and dark theme support
weaknesses: Releases in the 2.x.x range may introduce breaking changes requiring exact version pinning
Does not include built-in cloud backend syncing for events out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Pin the exact version (e.g. 2.0.0) as recommended to avoid breaking changes.

alternatives.name: table_calendar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a widely-used calendar widget focused primarily on a highly customizable table layout and event markers.
